info.title: Web app + Azure SQL + Key Vault
info.description: App Service (Linux) with a user-assigned identity, Entra-only Azure SQL, RBAC Key Vault with Key Vault references, Log Analytics, optional private endpoints.

metadata.description: Plan SKU name, e.g. B1, S1, P0v3, P1v3.
App Service plan size. Slots need Standard or higher; zone redundancy needs Premium v3 and 2+ instances.
Environments this template knows how to size. Add one here before adding a param file.
App setting name. Use __ for nested .NET config keys, e.g. Demo__ApiKey.
Secret name in the vault (letters, digits, dashes).
An app setting whose value comes from a Key Vault secret through a Key Vault reference.
Delegated to Microsoft.Web/serverFarms for App Service VNet integration. /27 or larger.
Holds the SQL and Key Vault private endpoints.
Address space for the optional private-networking layout.
e.g. GP_S_Gen5_1 (serverless) or GP_Gen5_2 (provisioned).

Serverless only. Minimum vCores while running.
Use the subscription's free Azure SQL offer (one database per subscription, serverless GP only).
Azure SQL database compute. Serverless SKUs (GP_S_*) honour autoPauseDelayMinutes and minCapacity.
Display name of the user, group, or app registration.
Object ID (users/groups) or service principal object ID (apps).
Microsoft Entra principal that administers the SQL server. Normally the pipeline's service principal or a DBA group.
Short workload name used in every resource name. Lowercase letters and digits.
Extra tags merged over the standard set.
Runtime stack for the Linux web app.
Creates a "staging" slot so the pipeline can deploy, smoke test, then swap.
Public client IPs allowed through the SQL firewall (e.g. a developer running DbSetup). Ignored with private networking.
Turns on Microsoft Defender for SQL on the server. Billed per server.
Purge protection cannot be turned off again once on. Keep it off in throwaway environments.
App settings resolved from Key Vault at runtime through Key Vault references.
Secret values to write into the vault, keyed by secret name. Empty values are skipped, so a run without them leaves existing secrets alone.
Puts SQL and Key Vault behind private endpoints and routes the web app through a VNet.
Email for metric alerts. Leave empty to skip alerting resources.
Identity allowed to send telemetry. Ingestion requires Entra auth, so the connection string alone is not enough.
